payload.title: Source Sans/Serif/Code fonts never load; switch fonts.stylesheet on when wanted
payload.description: layout.css imported the Google Fonts stylesheet after other rules, so browsers ignored it and the live site rendered the fallback stack (Georgia/system sans). The Papyrus migration kept that look. To use the intended Source Sans 3, Source Serif 4 and Source Code Pro, add fonts.stylesheet with the Google Fonts URL to web/projection.json and compare the layout.
